title: Venezuelan Beef Skewers
description: A classic Venezuelan dish featuring marinated beef skewers grilled to perfection, served with a side of quiet, roasted flavors.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lime juice, garlic, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
2. Add the beef cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
3. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
4. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
5. Thread the marinated beef cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
6. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the beef reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
7. Transfer the skewers to a plate and garnish with chopped cilantro.
8. Serve immediately, with a side of roasted vegetables or a salad.
